name: CHEG 2201
title: Chemical Engineering Professional Skills I
description: Professional skills necessary to succeed in the chemical engineering industry: written and oral technical communication; working on diverse and inclusive teams. The complexity of these skills will build over CHEG 2201, 3201, and 4101.
requirement_description: CHEM 1128Q or CHEM 1148Q, or CHEM 1125Q and 1126Q; MATH 1132Q; open only to Chemical Engineering students.
